Account deletion requests

Bounty accepts account and associated-data deletion requests at kunal26das@gmail.com. In the app, open Your corner → Request account deletion to read these instructions and compose an email. You can also send a request directly without reinstalling Bounty or creating another account.

Support handles requests manually and independently verifies account ownership before changes. Opening the email composer does not send a request automatically. A drafted or sent request, signing out, uninstalling Bounty, or deleting local files is not confirmation that the account has been deleted. The operator confirms the actual result and any retained data separately.

Automatic Cloud cleanup remains unavailable. Existing interrupted cleanup requests stay saved. If any requested data cannot yet be inspected or removed, support explains the unfinished steps instead of reporting the request complete.

How to request account or data deletion

Email kunal26das@gmail.com with the subject Bounty account deletion or Bounty data request. State whether you want the Bounty account and associated data removed, a copy of data, or help removing particular data. Include your sign-in provider, platform and the account email shown in Bounty if available. The Support ID in Your corner can help locate the account, but is not proof of ownership.

Do not send a provider password, sign-in code, ID/access/refresh token, full card details or private ledger. Support uses an independent account confirmation before changes; an incoming email address, display name, screenshot or purchase reference alone is not verification. You receive a separate completion or partial-result notice after the actual work. No completion deadline is promised by this draft.

You may export records and keep original receipt files before removal; this is optional and is not a condition for submitting a request. Account deletion can end access to the account and its Pro identity. Deleting a Bounty account does not cancel a Google Play or other native store subscription: manage renewal with the purchase provider separately.

What the prepared cloud cleanup removes and retains

When enabled and completed, the prepared cloud cleanup removes the Bounty sign-in account, cloud profile and memberships, the account's comments and uploaded receipt files. A group with no remaining members is removed. Shared groups with other members retain amounts, titles, notes, financial history and participant identifiers, while the removed participant is labelled Former member and its linked account and email fields are removed.

Retained titles, notes, identifiers and financial history may still contain personal information entered by users. This is not guaranteed anonymization or deletion of every occurrence of a person's information. The owner must confirm any justified retention, its duration and how a request to remove embedded personal data will be handled before launch.

The prepared cloud workflow does not automatically erase exported files, copies held by other participants, offline caches on other devices, or provider-held billing records. RevenueCat and storefront data need a separately verified handling process; this app's cloud deletion code does not prove those records were removed.

Local and browser records

Local and Demo workspaces are separate from a signed-in account. Signing out or deleting a cloud account does not remove them. To remove local app or browser records, use your device's app-data or browser site-data controls after saving anything you need. iOS Keychain can retain a sign-in credential independently of ledger files; sign out before removing the app when possible.

Files you exported or shared are separate copies. Remove those from their saved locations or ask their recipients where appropriate. Account deletion cannot remotely erase a copy you or another participant already exported.

Prepare a deletion request email ↗

Opens your email app. Review the message before sending; no request is submitted by this page. Sending a message does not confirm deletion or cancel a subscription.
